AI Prompt

Use AI without outsourcing your thinking.

Build a safe prompt, paste it into your model, and keep full ownership of your work.

Runs entirely in this browser tab. What you paste is not sent, saved, or stored in cookies or local storage.

Non-negotiable principles

Use AI for Do not use AI for
  • planning your own next steps rewriting your paragraphs or sentences
  • checking whether your explanation is clear adding arguments, examples, or angles you did not think of
  • flagging unsupported claims or weak links making your work sound more academic than you can explain
  • diagnosing SPAG issues without rewriting producing text you could submit
  • testing whether you can explain your choices aloud hiding how much of the thinking came from AI

Safe and unsafe requests

Safer Unsafe
  • Can you point out which paragraph is unclear and ask me a question about it? Can you rewrite this paragraph so it sounds more academic?
  • Can you show me where my claim is unsupported? Can you suggest a stronger argument I could use here?
  • Can you identify grammar issues without correcting them? Can you fix the grammar and improve the flow?
  • Can you ask me viva questions about this section? Can you give me ideal answers to possible viva questions?
  • Can you help me compare the ideas I have already listed? Can you give me three better ideas to use instead?

Before you start

  • Paste only the part of your work you actually want feedback on.
  • Be honest about whether you are still planning or already writing.
  • Keep a record of what help you asked for if your course requires AI use to be declared.
  • Do not keep pushing the model until it gives you wording you can copy.
  • If the response feels too polished, too advanced, or not really yours, stop using it.

You are responsible for what you submit.

AI can help you reflect, organise, and check. It must not become the hidden author of your work.

You should still be able to explain every decision, every argument, and every key phrase in your own words.

If your prompt or the AI response starts doing the thinking for you, stop and reset.
